create_exponential_distribution: create an Exponential distribution with a given rate parameter for sampling
sample_exponential_distribution: sample from an Exponential distribution using rsample with a specified sample shape
compute_exponential_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under an Exponential distribution
compute_exponential_cdf_icdf: compute the cumulative distribution function and inverse cdf of an Exponential distribution
compute_exponential_entropy: compute the entropy of an Exponential distribution from its rate parameter
